renderings.value: Another thing to avoid is to use too much praise.
She is probably just making a mountain out of a molehill again.
Everyone loves to hear praise, but over-praise has the opposite effect of sounding insincere.
The excessive use of salt should be taboo.
Mary fluctuates between having an exaggerated sense of her own importance and an inferiority complex.
If you're constantly trying to one-up others, you'll only end up harming yourself.
An excess of sugar in the blood is called diabetes.
